from the printers to whom the contract was first awarded, were deemed un

The Council recommends a change in the system of reporting Convention
proceedings. The present system of appointing recorders has resulted in a
series of records lacking uniformity, and in many instances, coherence

responsibUities, but it believes that if the duty of securing reports were com
mitted to it, the records which it is required to publish would be much more
satisfactory.
